d: Pivotal events unfold for Peter and the Fringe team.
The Fringe Team tracks a killer who targets love.
An unfamiliar case is familiar to Peter.
Lincoln works a case "over there" with the Alt Fringe team.
Walter travels to the Alternate Universe to help Broyles.
In this mind-bending episode, the story jumps ahead to 2036 when the Fringe team strikes back against the Observers in a game-changing battle.
The Cortexiphan children surface with new developments.
After a disappointing discovery, Clarke and Abby question how far they're willing to go.  Meanwhile, Jaha finds a lead to the mysterious Second Dawn.
Jasper and Bellamy go on a quest. Meanwhile, Clarke struggles to keep the peace after word of Jaha's discovery spreads.
Octavia fights in the final battle for her people's survival, but not everyone is willing to play fair.
Series star Henry Ian Cusick directs the episode in which Clarke faces the consequences of her fateful choice.
While Jaha and Kane disagree over how to handle their grim reality, Clarke leads a group to save a friend.
In the season finale, it's a race against the end of the world as Praimfaya arrives, forcing our heroes to make impossible choices to ensure their survival.
In the fifth season premiere, Clarke (ELIZA TAYLOR) struggles to survive on a desolate, scorched earth, while her friends in space come across a long-awaited beacon of hope.
Octavia (series star MARIE AVGEROPOULOS) is forced to take guidance from an unlikely ally when the future of the bunker and all those inside it is jeopardized.
Bellamy (BOB MORLEY) leads the charge investigating a potential way home.  Meanwhile, Clarke and Madi (LOLA FLANERY) deal with the new uncertain threat to their home.
A case of spontaneous combustion forces Walter to revisit his painful past, while the Fringe team faces off against David Robert Jones to save the world — or worlds.
In the Season Four finale, the Fringe team is pushed to their breaking point as they desperately attempt to prevent a catastrophic event threatening the lives of everyone.
In the fifth and final season premiere, Peter and his daughter Etta (GEORGINA HAIG) set out to find out what happened to Olivia.
The Fringe team revisits Walter's Harvard lab — now under Observer control — to locate information they need to fight on in their mission to save the world.
